video.title: Video podcast
video.intro: The whole episode ({{length}}) as a 16:9 video: the picture, a moving waveform, captions and who is speaking. For 3Speak, YouTube and Spotify video podcasts.
video.unavailable: This editor server can not make video podcasts yet.
video.tooLong: Video podcasts can be up to {{length}} long.
video.stageHint: The waveform moves with the sound, the captions and the name follow the episode.
video.captionsNoStt: Speech to text is not available on this server.
video.captionsStt: The words, found by speech to text on the server. Long episodes take a while.
video.noVoices: No voice track to take names from.
video.speaker: Speaker {{n}}
video.loudest: Each voice on its own track: the name of the loudest one shows.
video.lost: The job was lost (the server restarted?)
video.signIn: Sign in on 3Speak to make a video podcast.
video.failed: The video podcast could not be made: {{error}}

template.title: Your template
template.signedOutIntro: Save your intro, outro and music bed once, and every new recording gets them in one click. Your template is kept for good, so it needs your 3Speak sign-in.
template.signIn: Sign in to use a template
template.logIn: Log in on 3Speak to use a template.
template.intro: One template, kept for good. Saving replaces the one you had.

outro.title: Outro
outro.hint: Plays right after your recording ends.

bed.title: Music bed
bed.hint: Quiet music under the whole recording, looped to fit, faded out at the end.

template.useSelected: Use "{{name}}" (the part you trimmed it to)
template.selectFirst: Select an uploaded audio clip on the timeline first
template.loop: Loop to fill the whole recording
template.cutSilences: Cut the silences out of every new recording <small>(with your Cut silences settings)</small>
template.loudness: Normalize the loudness for podcasts <small>(-16 LUFS, applied when exporting)</small>
template.duck: Duck the music while someone talks <small>({{db}} dB on the music bed; change it in the clip's settings)</small>
template.autoApply: Apply it by itself when I open a recording
template.uploadFailed: That file could not be uploaded. Try another one.
